jobs.title: Technical Product Manager, Learning Science
jobs.description:
TECHNICAL PRODUCT MANAGER, LEARNING SCIENCE

Level is a learning technology company dedicated to helping students build real academic and life skills with confidence and joy. We combine proven curriculum principles with world class interactive design to make meaningful practice something students want to come back to, not something they struggle through.

We support what teachers, schools, and parents are already doing by increasing student engagement with high quality, standards aligned practice that reinforces classroom learning. That’s why we’re building:

For students: Rewarding and motivating learning experiences that meet students where they are to build real academic proficiency.

For educators: Tools that fit naturally into instruction and help students stay engaged while reducing teacher workload.

For parents: Activities that help your kid catch up or get ahead, build confidence, and minimize homework battles, whether learning at school or at home.

We are committed to helping every person maximize their potential and live a life of meaning. It’s a difficult problem that requires brilliant people and tremendous effort over time.

If you want to use your skills to make a difference for the world, we're seeking a Technical Product Manager who bridges the science of learning with product innovation. You'll define the vision and strategy for educational products that measurably improve teaching and learning outcomes, grounded in cognitive science, educational research, and data-driven insights.



What You'll Do:

 - Define product vision and roadmap for learning products, aligning technology with educational goals and learning science principles

 - Translate learning science research and user insights into product features that enhance how students learn and teachers teach

 - Lead cross-functional teams (engineering, design, content, research) to build products grounded in evidence-based learning practices

 - Use data analytics and learning metrics to validate hypotheses, measure impact, and guide product decisions

 - Deeply understand educators and students—their needs, workflows, and challenges—and advocate for them throughout the product lifecycle

 - Prioritize features and manage the product backlog with a focus on learning efficacy and user outcomes

What You Bring:

 - Strong product management foundation with experience defining strategy, building roadmaps, and shipping products

 - Deep understanding of learning science, cognitive psychology, or educational research

 - Technical fluency to collaborate effectively with engineering teams working on EdTech solutions

 - Data-driven mindset with experience using analytics to measure learning outcomes and product success

 - Exceptional communication skills to bridge technical teams, educators, and business stakeholders

 - Passion for education and commitment to improving learning experiences through thoughtful product design



Qualifications

Need to Have:

 - 3+ years of experience for Mid-Level, 5+ years of experience for Senior in a product management, data analysis, or related role within the education or growth tech industries

 - Proven experience managing telemetry systems and analyzing large datasets.

 - Experience with data visualization software (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).

 - Proficiency in Python and SQL for data manipulation and analysis.

 - Experience working with databases and data warehousing concepts.

 - Demonstrated ability to design, implement, and analyze A/B tests and other experiments.

 - Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights and recommendations.

 - Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively convey technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences.

 - A solid understanding of product development processes.



Nice to Have:

 - Experience in education - as an instructional designer, classroom educator, or similar

 - Familiarity with statistical analysis techniques.

 - Experience in a live operations environment, focusing on monetization and optimization.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
Level is a learning technology company dedicated to helping students build real academic and life skills with confidence and joy. We combine proven curriculum principles with world class interactive design to make meaningful practice something students want to come back to, not something they struggle through.

We support what teachers, schools, and parents are already doing by increasing student engagement with high quality, standards aligned practice that reinforces classroom learning. That’s why we’re building:

For students: Rewarding and motivating learning experiences that meet students where they are to build real academic proficiency.

For educators: Tools that fit naturally into instruction and help students stay engaged while reducing teacher workload.

For parents: Activities that help your kid catch up or get ahead, build confidence, and minimize homework battles, whether learning at school or at home.

We are committed to helping every person maximize their potential and live a life of meaning. It’s a difficult problem that requires brilliant people and tremendous effort over time.

Level is seeking a driven and technically fluent Senior Technical Product Manager to join our Online Platform  department. This role sits at the intersection of engineering and business strategy, translating complex technical requirements into clear product roadmaps that deliver measurable user and organizational value. You'll serve as the connective tissue between engineering, design, and business stakeholders, owning the product lifecycle from discovery through delivery and ensuring that what we build is both technically sound and strategically aligned.



What You Will Do:

 - Product Roadmap Ownership: Define, prioritize, and maintain a clear product roadmap that reflects business goals, user needs, and technical constraints, communicating it effectively across the organization.

 - Technical Discovery & Scoping: Partner closely with engineering teams to evaluate feasibility, surface technical risks, and scope features with precision — translating ambiguous requirements into well-defined deliverables.

 - Stakeholder Alignment: Facilitate alignment across engineering, design, marketing, and leadership on product direction, trade-offs, and release decisions.

 - Requirements & Specifications: Author detailed product requirements documents (PRDs), user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineering teams can execute against with clarity and confidence.

 - Delivery & Execution: Drive sprint planning, backlog grooming, and release coordination, ensuring that teams are unblocked and shipping on schedule.

 - User Research & Feedback Loops: Champion the voice of the user by synthesizing qualitative and quantitative feedback, usability research, and support insights into product decisions.

 - Metrics & Performance Tracking: Define success metrics for product initiatives and monitor post-launch performance, using data to iterate and improve.

 - API & Platform Strategy: Own the product strategy for platform and API products, including developer-facing tooling, integrations, and infrastructure-adjacent features.

 - Experimentation: Design and oversee A/B tests and feature experiments, translating results into actionable next steps for the team.

 - Documentation & Process: Maintain thorough product documentation, including feature specs, decision logs, and process guides, to ensure continuity and institutional knowledge across the team.



Qualifications

Need to Have:

 - 6+ years of experience in product management, with at least 3 years in a technical product management role at a software or technology company.

 - Demonstrated ability to work directly with engineering teams and engage fluently in technical conversations around architecture, APIs, data models, and system design.

 - Strong track record of owning and delivering complex software products end to end, from discovery through launch and iteration.

 - Proficiency in agile methodologies and tools (Jira, Linear, Shortcut, or equivalent), with hands-on experience leading sprint ceremonies and managing backlogs.

 - Experience defining and tracking product KPIs, with comfort using analytics platforms (Mixpanel, Amplitude, Looker, or equivalent) to inform decisions.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences and vice versa.

 - Proven ability to manage competing priorities, navigate ambiguity, and drive alignment in a fast-moving environment.

 - Strong judgment in making trade-off decisions across scope, quality, and timelines.

Nice to Have:

 - Background in software engineering, data science, or a related technical discipline.

 - Experience building and managing developer-facing products, APIs, or platform/infrastructure features.

 - Familiarity with cloud infrastructure concepts (AWS, GCP, Azure) and how they influence product architecture decisions.

 - Experience working in a B2B SaaS or enterprise software environment.

 - Exposure to AI/ML product development, including working with model teams or integrating LLM capabilities into products.

 - Knowledge of data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) and their product implications.

 - Experience with design tools (Figma or equivalent) and a working familiarity with UX principles.

 - Proven success launching products in a 0-to-1 or early-stage environment.

 - Public-facing portfolio work, conference talks, or writing that demonstrates product thinking and communication skills.
